verdict.rationale: Asaas ships its own background automations: notifications sent automatically before and after a due date on the user's chosen channels, invoice automation configured once, and recurring subscriptions or Automatic Pix charges. These are fixed, domain-specific automations rather than a general, user-configurable or agent-driven background workflow engine. missing for 10: a general automation or workflow builder with custom triggers and actions, agent-driven autonomous execution, scheduling controls or run monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Envie notificações automáticas antes e depois do vencimento. Você escolhe os canais: WhatsApp, e-mail, SMS ou robô de voz.
Com a automação de notas fiscais, você cadastra os dados da sua empresa apenas uma vez e se livra da papelada para sempre.
When creating recurring Automatic Pix payments in MANUAL mode, provide the pixAutomaticAuthorizationId of an ACTIVE authorization.
